# Club Copy

> Club Copy is an independent Pacific Northwest record label based in British Columbia, Canada. House, jungle, and adjacent electronic music — digital and cassette. It also runs a digital and physical record club for collecting those releases.

Club Copy is a record label imprint under Copy House Publishing that operates a record club (Free alerts, Club $5/yr member pricing, Premium from $10/yr with Club Credit). Founded by Charlie Archer (CJ Archer). Nothing ships unless you choose it.
